_comment: The single source of truth for what every part of the UI does. Rendered as the searchable glossary in Training AND used as tooltip text across the app, so the manual and the tooltip can never disagree. Keys are stable; add, do not rename.

entries.label: My Pipeline
entries.does: Your work for today, already in the order it should be done.
entries.when: Start here every morning and work top to bottom.

entries.label: Floor
entries.does: The live floor: leaderboard, who is on shift, and what is leaking.
entries.when: Twice a day if you run a team.

entries.label: Collections
entries.does: The client book: everyone who has paid, one row per product bought, with the group/KYC/MITC checkpoints, who converted them and the lead source. Was called Advisory clients.
entries.when: After every payment, to clear the checkpoints; to add or correct a client.

entries.label: Outstanding payments
entries.does: Money still owed: instalments, promises to pay, who to chase, and the payment punch-in. Was called Collections.
entries.when: Daily if you have closed any deal.

entries.label: Mentors
entries.does: Paying clients kept warm: touchpoints, health chips and upsell interest.
entries.when: Daily if you are a mentor; when hunting warm upsell if you are a counsellor.

entries.label: Events
entries.does: Seminars and webinars with the roster of who was invited and who came.
entries.when: Before an event to build the roster, after it to work the follow-ups.

entries.label: Dashboards
entries.does: Charts: conversion, collections over time, the funnel and pipeline leakage.
entries.when: Weekly, or when a number needs explaining.

entries.label: Find lead
entries.does: Search and filter every lead you are allowed to see.
entries.when: Any time you need a list — this is the re-tap tool.

entries.label: Performance
entries.does: Per-person dials, connects, talk time, walk-ins and conversion.
entries.when: Weekly one-to-ones, and before any coaching conversation.

entries.label: Previous months
entries.does: Older uploaded records, parked out of the live queue but still tappable.
entries.when: Running a re-tap campaign on old data.

entries.label: Team
entries.does: Team chat. Everyone can post, to their team or the whole floor.
entries.when: Anything the floor needs to know now.

entries.label: My Score
entries.does: Your score and what each component measures.
entries.when: For self-reflection — it is not a ranking board.

entries.label: Attendance
entries.does: Your hours, day by day, against the 9-hour expectation.
entries.when: Checking your own week.

entries.label: Training
entries.does: Every rule and every screen explained, with a quiz and an acknowledgement.
entries.when: Your first week, and whenever a module changes.

entries.label: Admin
entries.does: Users, lead sources, settings, security alerts and quarantine.
entries.when: Admins and ops only.

entries.label: Start shift
entries.does: Opens your attendance session for today.
entries.when: The moment you sit down. No shift, no fresh leads, no hours.

entries.label: Log call
entries.does: Records an attempt: outcome, talk time in MM:SS, and the next action.
entries.when: As you finish each call, never in a batch.

entries.label: Book walk-in
entries.does: Schedules a visit and puts it on the counsellor's pipeline immediately.
entries.when: The moment someone commits to coming in.

entries.label: Transfer
entries.does: Moves a lead to another caller, with a reason, recorded in the audit log.
entries.when: Counsellors and admins only, when the owner genuinely cannot progress it.

entries.label: WhatsApp sent
entries.does: Marks that you sent a message. Manual — the CRM cannot detect it.
entries.when: Straight after sending, so your re-tap lists work later.

entries.label: Import leads
entries.does: Copies filtered leads onto an event roster. Originals are never modified.
entries.when: Building an event roster. Preview first — the count is exact.

entries.label: ◐ Theme
entries.does: Switches between the light and dark themes. Remembered on this browser.
entries.when: Whenever the room's lighting changes.

entries.label: Password
entries.does: Changes your own password while signed in.
entries.when: Any time. Ask an admin instead if you are locked out.

entries.label: Overdue
entries.does: Leads whose next action time has passed, in working hours.
entries.when: First thing every morning.

entries.label: Untouched
entries.does: Assigned leads nobody has dialled yet.
entries.when: Before the ten-minute rule moves them off your list.

entries.label: Callbacks today
entries.does: Callbacks scheduled for today that are still pending.
entries.when: Several times a day. A missed callback is the most expensive miss.

entries.label: Follow-up round (FU1–FU5)
entries.does: Filters by how many attempts a lead has had.
entries.when: Running a structured re-tap: 'everyone due their 3rd follow-up'.

entries.label: No WhatsApp sent
entries.does: Leads you spoke to but never messaged.
entries.when: One of the most productive re-tap lists there is.

entries.label: Last outcome
entries.does: Filters by the most recent call outcome.
entries.when: Building a 'not answered' or 'will call back' sweep.

entries.label: Immediate
entries.does: A high-intent lead who asked to be contacted now.
entries.when: Call before anything else on your list.

entries.label: Green (client health)
entries.does: Touched recently, went fine, nothing overdue.
entries.when: No action needed.

entries.label: Amber (client health)
entries.does: A touch is due, or the last attempt did not land.
entries.when: Work after the reds.

entries.label: Red (client health)
entries.does: A concern was raised, the client has gone quiet, or a follow-up is badly overdue.
entries.when: Call today. Work these first.

entries.label: ACE
entries.does: Best relative walk-in conversion; holds the guaranteed share of fresh leads.
entries.when: Recomputed regularly — it is earned, not permanent.

entries.label: RESTRICTED
entries.does: Receives no fresh leads. Still receives transfers, re-taps and imports.
entries.when: Exit by converting walk-ins from any source — they count the same.

entries.label: Verified
entries.does: The logged call matches an entry in the phone's own call log.
entries.when: These are the numbers nobody can argue with.

entries.label: Unverified
entries.does: A logged call with no matching device entry.
entries.when: One or two is noise. A pattern is a conversation.

entries.label: Ticker strip
entries.does: Today's collected, fresh leads, walk-ins, conversions and headcount, against yesterday.
entries.when: Glance at it; it refreshes itself every minute.

entries.label: Today banner
entries.does: Your own numbers: dials against target, untouched, overdue. Managers see the floor.
entries.when: Dismiss it once you have read it — it returns tomorrow.

entries.label: Lunch freeze banner
entries.does: Counts down the 14:00–14:30 window when the clock and all engines pause.
entries.when: Nothing breaches while it is showing.

entries.label: Lead flow
entries.does: Why each caller is or is not receiving leads, including who was passed over and why.
entries.when: Whenever someone asks 'why am I not getting leads?'.

entries.label: Pipeline leakage
entries.does: Everything sitting where it should not be, by type and severity.
entries.when: Work it to zero before you leave. Empty means the pipeline is clean.

entries.label: Collection thermometer
entries.does: Collected month-to-date against the office breakeven, with the pace check.
entries.when: Weekly, and any time the month feels off.

entries.label: Warm pipeline
entries.does: Paying clients a mentor has flagged as upsell candidates.
entries.when: Counsellors: this is a pre-qualified call list.

entries.label: Fresh leads
entries.does: Every lead nobody has ever contacted, flagged if past its first-touch deadline.
entries.when: First thing every morning. Work it to empty.

entries.label: Enquired again
entries.does: This person filled a lead form again and nobody has dialled them since. Same lead record, resurfaced on the Fresh tab — never duplicated — with the owner alerted.
entries.when: Call first: the earlier attempt may have gone to spam and never rung. The badge clears when a call is logged after the re-enquiry.

entries.label: Alerts
entries.does: Everything waiting on you, grouped by what is wrong, with reschedule actions.
entries.when: Start of day, after lunch, and before you leave.

entries.label: Re-tap
entries.does: Leads that went unanswered repeatedly. They raise no alerts and are worked as a batch.
entries.when: When the five-day re-tap reminder arrives, or any quiet hour.

entries.label: Quiet lead
entries.does: Unanswered past the threshold, so it no longer interrupts. Still open, owned and counted.
entries.when: Work it from the Re-tap tab, longest silence first.

entries.label: Late / Badly late (fresh)
entries.does: A never-contacted lead past its first-touch deadline.
entries.when: Call before anything else on the Fresh leads tab.

entries.label: Paperwork open
entries.does: A paying client whose group / KYC / MITC checklist is unfinished.
entries.when: Clear it on the Collections tab; worth knowing before you call them.

entries.label: Add a client
entries.does: Enters a paying client who paid outside the CRM, creating a real lead, deal and payment.
entries.when: Offline sales and migrated records only — CRM payments appear automatically.

entries.label: Hand out now
entries.does: Runs the held-lead sweep immediately instead of waiting for the next minute.
entries.when: Admins, right after fixing whatever was blocking distribution.

entries.label: Snooze / reschedule
entries.does: Moves a lead's next action on the working clock and records the decision in its history.
entries.when: Only when you genuinely cannot get to it today.

entries.label: Waiting leads by team
entries.does: Unassigned leads grouped by team with the exact rule blocking each group.
entries.when: Whenever the Floor says leads are waiting — it names the fix.

entries.label: Add lead
entries.does: Enters a lead that did not come through the sheet — phone-in, walk-past, referral. Fair distribution by default.
entries.when: Counsellors, admins, ops. Never re-type a sheet lead; duplicates are refused.

entries.label: Punch in a payment
entries.does: Records money against a client by name — spread oldest instalment first, overpayments refused.
entries.when: The moment money arrives, on the Outstanding payments tab.

entries.label: Punch in for a new client
entries.does: Inside the payment punch-in: records a first payment from somebody with no open deal. Opens the Add-a-client form, asking who converted them and what the lead source was.
entries.when: The person paying is not in the book yet. If a search finds their open deal, use that instead.

entries.label: Converted by
entries.does: Names the counsellor whose sale this is. The deal, its team, and the collections chasing all follow this person — not whoever typed the entry.
entries.when: On every hand-entered client. An admin doing data entry must name the counsellor who actually closed.

entries.label: Edit (client)
entries.does: Corrects a client record on Collections. Name and phone on any client; product, amount, paid date, mode, reference, converted-by and source only on hand-entered clients. Every change is written to the client's history with old and new values.
entries.when: Typos and wrong entries. Money recorded through the CRM itself is an audit record and cannot be edited.

entries.label: Total payment / Down payment
entries.does: Two numbers on a hand-entered client: the full fee agreed, and what was actually received now. Any difference becomes a real instalment on Outstanding payments, with a due date.
entries.when: Every hand entry. Paid in full — type the total and the down payment follows it.

entries.label: Due (Collections)
entries.does: What is still to collect from that client, in red, with the date the balance falls due — the Total minus the Paid column.
entries.when: Anything above zero is money the closer is chasing on Outstanding payments.

entries.label: Record this payment against it
entries.does: Appears inside Add-a-client when the typed phone number already belongs to someone with an open deal: one click records the typed amount against that deal instead of creating a duplicate.
entries.when: Whenever the form tells you the person is already in the book. If the deal is with the other team, they record it; if it is fully paid, correct the amount with Edit instead.

entries.label: Lead source
entries.does: Where this client originally came from — the sheet, the website, a referral, or Manual entry. Keeps source reporting honest for clients entered by hand.
entries.when: On every hand-entered client. Pick the true origin; 'Manual entry' just means the CRM never saw them before.
